jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-17m.note: Measured floors from runs/stage1 (4000 steps, 16.8M source, byte-level BPE). Observed at that run: cos_emb_c 0.90, sim_corr 0.89, boundary_acc 0.990, nn_agree 0.31 against a 0.008 chance rate. Set below the observed values so a modestly worse rerun still ships, and far above the randomly-initialised interface's cos -0.008 / sim_corr 0.145 / boundary 0.000.

jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-32m.note: Same family and tokenizer as the 17m anchor. Bounds are the anchor's, not measured on this model; treat them as a starting point to be replaced by a measurement.

sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.note: WordPiece, and an uncased one. Roughly one byte position in five is not covered by the suffix trie, and the tokenizer's normaliser rewrites text, so this artifact is materially weaker than a byte-level one. Coverage is not gated.

bert-base-uncased.note: WordPiece, uncased. Same caveats as all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

xlm-roberta-base.note: SentencePiece. About three byte positions in four are uncovered by the suffix trie on non-Latin script.
